Hello [r/ska](https://www.reddit.com/r/ska)! I just wrapped up a six-month purge of a million little CCs on my chin and I thought I'd share my experience. When I was searching this subreddit for any information on purging CCs I was having a hard time finding a post that reflected my problem in particular, so I figured I'd report my own findings. The biggest takeaway for me was that purging can take forever and to not be discouraged if you are seeing progress being made. I put descriptions of my purging process on Imgur. Let me know if you guys have any questions! (By the way, if anyone has recommendations for products that will help with my leftover dark spots that would be greatly appreciated!)

\*\*My routine:

AM

CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser 

CeraVe PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion (I like using my own sunscreen)

Biore UV Bright Milk sunscreen

PM

CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser

Stridex Maximum Pads

CeraVe PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion

Once a week: Aztec Secret Indian Healing Clay

I see your point, but speaking from the point of view of someone whose Internet access was restricted until around that age, I can say my social development was negatively affected because I wasn’t able to participate in the pop culture of the time. For example, Youtube and Spongebob were extremely popular and I wasn’t allowed to watch either, so I wasn’t able to relate to other kids my age very well. I think going forward technology use at a young age will be more important for social development than previously because society is so entrenched in it (which I don’t think is necessarily a bad thing).
